title: AI Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure\-to\-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start\-up. You will find a unique home here.
   

  

 And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000\. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.
   

  

 Read more about apexanalytix \- https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/
   

  

****Quick Take \-****
 As an AI Engineer, you’ll drive the end\-to\-end development of advanced GenAI applications, including agentic AI agents with autonomous workflows, function calling, and LLM model fine\-tuning. This role is for an experienced engineer who excels at building robust, production\-grade AI systems and pushing the boundaries of what GenAI can accomplish.
   

  

****The Work \-****
* Fine\-tune and deploy open\-source general purpose LLMs and code\-generation models (e.g. Llama 4, qwen2\.5\) using PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF, etc..
* Design GenAI applications with agentic capabilities—autonomous, goal\-driven agents that can plan, reason, and execute multi\-step workflows with minimal human input.
* Implement function calling in workflows, enabling models to invoke external tools, APIs, databases, and services to perform actions or access real\-time data.
* Build agentic RAG pipelines, where LLMs coordinate data retrieval and reasoning dynamically via retrieval\-augmented generation.
* Create and maintain scalable pipelines, including data ingestion, labeling, feature engineering, vector DB management, and MLOps frameworks (MLflow, Kubeflow).
* Containerize applications using Kubernetes and Docker.
* Optimize and monitor model performance, including latency, drift, bias, privacy, and security compliance.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally, mediating between data, product, and engineering teams to translate requirements into agentic GenAI solutions.
* Stay current with research trends like agentic RL frameworks (e.g., ARTIST), multi\-agent orchestration, MCP, and secure function calling.


****The Must\-Haves \-****
* B.S or M.S. in Computer Science, Data Science, ML/AI or equivalent.
* 3\-5 years building and deploying AI/ML solutions with demonstrable production experience.
* Extensive experience fine\-tuning LLMs and code models with advanced techniques (PEFT/LoRA/QLoRa/RLHF).
* Proven track record designing or delivering agentic GenAI applications—function calling, autonomous workflows, RAG pipelines.
* Proficient in Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, LangGraph or similar frameworks.
* Experience in Document and Image Analysis and extracting insights from unstructured data, including text documents and images.
* Strong infrastructure skills: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, MLOps tooling.
* Sharp analytical mindset for system optimization, error mitigation, and security best practices.
* Excellent problem\-solving and ability to translate business needs into technical design.


 Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way \- https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/
   

  

****We are currently unable to offer Visa Sponsorship; candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship now as well as in the future.****
**Benefits**
 At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.
   

  

 With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:

You will work closely with engineering teams to collect, clean, and structure data, then apply it to ML workflows.

 •Build and maintain web/app scraping pipelines to collect data from external and internal sources
 



 •Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines to clean, transform, and structure scraped and internal data
 



 •Build browser automation scripts using Selenium/Puppeteer for scraping and workflow automation
 



 •Use collected data to build and support demand planning and forecasting ML models.
 



 •Analyze historical sales/demand data to identify trends and inform forecasting models
 



 •Write clean, well\-documented Python code for data and ML workflows
 



 •Support basic AI\-powered feature work using LLMs and related APIs (OpenAI, LangChain, etc.) as needed
 



 •Run experiments and evaluations to test model outputs and iterate on performance

 Required
 



 •Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field
 



 •Working proficiency in Python
 



 •Working knowledge of Selenium and/or Puppeteer for browser automation and scraping
 



 •Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and building data pipelines
 



 •Basic understanding of SQL and relational databases

 •Strong problem\-solving skills and eagerness to learn
 



  





 Good to Have:
 



 •Familiarity with LLMs and AI integrations (OpenAI, LangChain, or similar)
 



 •Exposure to additional scraping tools (BeautifulSoup, Scrapy)

 •Personal projects or coursework involving data pipelines, forecasting, or AI/ML
